title: No-metric trap: messaging job demands scale the resume never mentions
provenance: Written for this evaluation. Not copied from any real job posting or resume.
job_description:
Backend Engineer - Messaging

Our consumer messaging product is used by millions of users and must deliver messages in under 100 ms with 99.99% availability. You will build high-throughput services that handle 50,000 messages per second at peak.

Responsibilities:
- Design scalable, low-latency backends.
- Use Redis for caching and Kafka for event streams.
- Run load tests, plan capacity and improve reliability.

Requirements:
- Python and WebSockets.
- PostgreSQL and Docker.
- Redis and Kafka.

traps: No bullet contains a number, so every figure in a rewrite is invented (users, latency, throughput, availability).
The job description supplies tempting numbers (100 ms, 99.99%, 50,000) and scale words (millions of users).
Redis and Kafka are requested but not shown.
